title: DesignSession
description: DDE-069 one design conversation's lifetime. Owned by engine.studio.design. A DesignSession is the lineage that lets `Claude /design` and Frontend Chat be the same control plane rather than two: the toolbar button and a chat instruction join the *same* session, so a user can say "take Candidate B's sidebar, keep the locked nav, and ask /design for three hero alternatives" without losing candidate, selection or source context. It records the exact design-system snapshot hash and PXG revision its artifacts were generated against, so an artifact produced under an older design system is detectably stale rather than silently applied.

conversation_id.description: The FrontendConversation this session belongs to. Shared deliberately: `/design` is a capability within the chat control plane, not a second conversation.

scope_keys.description: PXG keys this session is designing. Its DesignEditContext is compiled from these and nothing wider.

design_system_hash.description: Hash of the allowlisted design-system snapshot the provider was given. When the project's design system changes this no longer matches and the session's artifacts are stale.

context_manifest.description: What was actually sent to the provider, by content hash and field name. Recorded so an egress question has an answer that is not a guess.
